title: Joint-Range Inequalities for Nonconvex QCQPs
summary: We study cutting planes for nonconvex quadratically constrained quadratic programs (QCQPs) through a project-then-lift approach inspired by mixed-integer rounding (MIR) inequalities. Given two base valid inequalities for the extended QCQP formulation, we project the associated two-row relaxation into a two-dimensional set and analyze the joint range of quadratic functions in two base inequalities.
